triples.tail_surface: removed from the assembly for repair or replacement without having to dismantle the complete unit
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 无需拆卸整体即可拆下维修或更换
triples.evidence_text: All components of the semiconductor converter assembly are to be mounted in such a manner that they can be removed from the assembly for repair or replacement without having to dismantle the complete unit.

triples.tail_surface: means of monitoring the temperature of the cooling medium
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 冷却介质温度监测装置
triples.evidence_text: Semiconductor assemblies with forced cooling are to be provided with a means of monitoring the temperature of the cooling medium. Over-temperature of the cooling medium is to be alarmed locally and at a continuously manned location and the equipment shutdown when temperature exceeds the manufacturer specified value.

triples.tail_surface: alarmed locally and at a continuously manned location
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 本地及有人值守处所报警
triples.evidence_text: Over-temperature of the cooling medium is to be alarmed locally and at a continuously manned location and the equipment shutdown when temperature exceeds the manufacturer specified value.

triples.tail_surface: equipment shutdown when temperature exceeds the manufacturer specified value
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 温度超过制造商规定值时设备停机
triples.evidence_text: Over-temperature of the cooling medium is to be alarmed locally and at a continuously manned location and the equipment shutdown when temperature exceeds the manufacturer specified value.

Semiconductor assemblies with liquid cooling are to be provided with a means to detect leakage. In case of leakage, an audible and visible alarm is to be initiated locally and remotely at a continuously manned location.

triples.tail_surface: audible and visible alarm is to be initiated locally and remotely at a continuously manned location
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 本地及远程有人值守处所声光报警
triples.evidence_text: In case of leakage, an audible and visible alarm is to be initiated locally and remotely at a continuously manned location.
Means to contain any leakage are to be provided so that the liquid does not cause a failure of the semi-conductor assembly or any other electrical equipment located near the converter.

Where the cooling liquid is required to be non-conducting, the conductivity of the cooling liquid is to be monitored and an alarm given both locally and remotely in a continuously manned location if the conductivity exceeds the manufacturer specified value.

triples.tail_surface: alarm is to be given both locally and remotely at a continuously manned location
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 本地及远程有人值守处所报警
triples.evidence_text: In case of failure of the cooling system, an alarm is to be given both locally and remotely at a continuously manned location and the output current is to be reduced automatically.

triples.tail_surface: output current is to be reduced automatically
triples.evidence_text: In case of failure of the cooling system, an alarm is to be given both locally and remotely at a continuously manned location and the output current is to be reduced automatically.
